style_block: Warm sun-flared 35mm consumer film look, soft film grain, slight light leaks at the frame edges, warm golden color cast, natural available light (window light, late-afternoon sun, porch light at dusk), candid unposed framing like a snapshot caught mid-moment, period-accurate 1990s teen fashion and hairstyles, generic unbranded packaging and signage rendered as plain shapes rather than real logos, no modern devices or fixtures visible anywhere. Strictly no readable text, words, letters, numbers, or lettering of any kind anywhere in the frame - no signs, no labels, no posters, nothing legible.
reference_notes: Warm film-grain photo-real, a warmer/softer alternative to the desaturated documentary look used on POV: Life in the 90s. Original art only - no real brands, logos, or trademarked characters/shows. Dialogue is spoken audio (Gemini Omni Flash native generation), not on-screen text, so the no-text rule is unaffected by it.
